found: the Version "4.2.70000.0" is not four 16-bit numbers: 70000 is above 65535, the largest 16-bit part
fix: write the version as four numbers from 0 to 65535, such as 1.4.2.0; a build number of a pipeline above 65535 does not fit

found: the protocol "ms-ledger" of the application "App" is reserved (ms-*): Windows or the web already handles that scheme, so the registration competes with it for every link
fix: use a scheme of the app's own, such as contoso-notes; to open web links, let the default browser handle them

found: the file type association name "Ledger Book" of the application "App" is not valid: it is not all lowercase
fix: name the protocol with a lowercase scheme of its own, such as contoso-notes, and the file type association with a lowercase name; write each FileType as .ext

found: the application "App" has an Executable but no EntryPoint and no uap10:RuntimeBehavior, so Windows does not know how to activate it
fix: give the application its Id and Executable, and EntryPoint="Windows.FullTrustApplication" for a desktop app (or uap10:RuntimeBehavior and uap10:TrustLevel)

found: the Id "App" is already used by the application at line 33; each application of a package needs an Id of its own
fix: give each application of the package an Id of its own, and keep the Id of a published app as it is, because the Start tile follows it

found: the uap:VisualElements of the application "App" has no Description
fix: give uap:VisualElements its DisplayName, Description, BackgroundColor, Square150x150Logo and Square44x44Logo

found: the MinVersion 10.0.16299.0 of Windows.Universal (build 16299) is below the floor 10.0.17763.0 (build 17763), so the package installs on builds the team may not test or Microsoft may no longer service
fix: raise MinVersion to a build the app is tested on and Microsoft still services, or lower minBuildFloor when the team supports the older build on purpose

found: the Language "en_IE" is not a well-formed BCP 47 tag: it holds a character other than letters, digits and hyphens; BCP 47 separates subtags with a hyphen

found: runFullTrust is a restricted capability: the package holds full-trust code, such as a packaged desktop app, that runs at medium integrity outside the app container; a Store submission must say why the app needs it, and the Store may refuse it
